DebugAdaptersDescType.description: Contains the list of supported debug adapters.

alias-name.description: List of names (in input node or BSP) that map to this debug adapter.

template.description: Used only by the VS Code CMSIS Solution extension for configuration.

DebugAdaptersDefaultsType.description: List of default options to use when not specified in the target-set: node.

active.description: Add the gdbserver: node in the cbuild-run.yml file.
Add the telnet: node in the cbuild-run.yml file.

section.description: Section label, supporting ${{ expression }} expansion. Omitted, null, or empty labels hide the heading.

description.description: Description of the section, supporting ${{ expression }} expansion.

condition.description: Boolean or complete ${{ expression }} controlling availability. Only boolean true makes the section available. Expressions can read config, device, and processors.

condition-message.description: Warning shown when a configured section's condition is false. Supports ${{ expression }} expansion.

type.description: Type of the user interface element.

path-type.description: Type of the path (for file type).

select.description: If present, the section can be enabled or disabled, applying to all options. Accepts legacy on/off strings.

collapsible.description: Allow content sections to collapse. Unlabeled sections stay expanded.

subsections.description: Nested sections using the same declaration format, including expression expansion.

subsections-layout.description: Display subsections as content or nested navigation entries.

usage.description: Marks addable subsections (available) or configured instances (used).

pname-options.description: Deprecated: repeat options per processor using subsections with yml-node.value: '${{ processors.name }}' instead.

SectionYamlNodeType.description: Group node under debugger in csolution.yml, as a name or a mapping. String names, mapping names, and marker values support ${{ expression }} expansion using config, device, and processors.

name.description: Group node name or marker name identifying a sequence entry.

kind.description: Container kind for the section's options and subsections.

value.description: Entry marker value. An array expands into one section per value. Null markers are retained by default. Only arrays in this field create multiple sections.

optional.description: With value, omit null or empty markers while retaining the entry and its options.

select.description: Bind the section's enabled state to a stored option instead of node presence.

node.description: Option name holding the enabled state.

selected.description: Enabled value or aliases; the first value is written.

unselected.description: Disabled value or aliases; the first value is written.

SectionSwitchValuesType.description: A stored switch value or non-empty list of aliases, with the first value used when writing.

yml-node.description: YAML node in the cbuild-run.yml file.

value.description: Actual value to use in the YAML file.

values.description: List of possible values (for enum type).

range.description: Range of valid values in display scale (for number type).

default.description: Default value for the option (for number types in display scale).

scale.description: Display scaling of the option (for number type). E.g. 1000 to display a value stored in Hz as kHz.
